name: aol-tms-enterprise
description: AOL Transport Management System - Enterprise Edition

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules client/dist server/dist
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed

author: AOL Transport Solutions
